summary: Rulebank compaction job produced inconsistent index entries causing autoroute misclassification and SLA reporting spikes
description: Issue summary: During a scheduled rulebank compaction (index compactor v2.3.1) at 2026-03-10T03:02:00Z, the compaction job wrote inconsistent index fragments for ~420 routing templates. Impact: internal autoroute started misclassifying inbound support issues, causing routing to fallback to default escalation lanes and inflating SLA breach metrics for the last 12 hours. Observed behavior: multiple internal tickets were assigned to the wrong team, autoroute reports show duplicate rule hits, and weekly SLA aggregates show +4.7% breach. Scope: affects rulebank shard rb-us-east-3 only; no customer-facing API outages observed but internal support SLAs and escalation dashboards are affected.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger rulebank compaction job on rb-us-east-3 with default compaction window (30d)
2) Observe compactor logs for overlapping write events and duplicate index IDs
3) Query routing-engine with PRIO=high sample tickets and verify misclassification latency
4) Check support-console routing trace for duplicate-rule evaluation paths
logs: compactor stderr tail: 2026-03-10T03:02:05Z ERROR compactor: fragment write conflict: shard=rb-us-east-3 fragment_id=7a9c2f duplicate_key=rule-8732
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: race in compaction worker pool causing duplicate fragment writes when compaction window overlaps ongoing edits.
Confirmed: compactor v2.3.1 contains a change that switched from optimistic append to parallel shard-writes; code review shows missing per-fragment lock in write path (see PR #1287).

Routing engine behavior: when rulebank index contains duplicate rule IDs, evaluator short-circuits to first match and records both hits in routing trace which downstream tooling interprets as duplicate escalations.
SRE snapshot: rb-us-east-3 had elevated edit throughput around 2026-03-09 23:00-03:30 UTC due to bulk template import job INT-287654 which increased compaction pressure.
mitigation_steps: 1) Temporarily disabled scheduled compaction on rb-us-east-3 (2026-03-10T04:10Z).
2) Applied a stop-gap patch to compactor to enforce per-fragment lock (hotfix branch compactor-fix/lock-guard).
3) Ran a repair pass that deduplicated index fragments using dedupe tool v0.9.4 (dry-run successful on staging).
4) Re-ran autoroute backfill to rebuild routing hit metrics once index integrity confirmed.
resolution_notes: Work is ongoing. Hotfix applied to stop further corrupt compactions and a repair/dedup job is scheduled for 2026-03-12T02:00Z with outage window for internal routing metrics. After repair, perform full regression on routing traces and SLA aggregates. Follow-up action: add per-shard write locks to compactor v2.4 and add compaction canary that validates fragment id monotonicity before committing.
